network.availablePortHelp: Suggestions show available TCP ports. Availability is checked again when saving.
network.noAvailablePorts: No free TCP ports in enabled pools. Ask an administrator for another pool.
network.removePoolHelp: Remove this pool? Only pools without allocations or reservations can be removed.
network.connectionHelp: Enter the host running services. A public domain is not required for local testing.
network.connectionHostHelp: Enter localhost, 127.0.0.1, a LAN/public IP or DNS name. Do not include a protocol, path or port; ports are assigned per service.
network.localHelp: localhost and 127.0.0.1 work only on the same computer. From another device use the node LAN address. This does not change the agent API address or public DNS.
network.publicDnsHelp: This section is exclusively for public domains. Use the connection address above for local tests. localhost and private IPs are not published to DNS.
network.hostnameHelp: A real public DNS hostname without a protocol or port. Without a domain, leave public DNS unconfigured and set a local/LAN address.
network.ipv4Help: The node public IPv4. Enter 127.0.0.1 or private addresses such as 192.168.x.x in the connection address section instead.
network.ipv6Help: Optional public IPv6. Leave blank if unavailable. Public DNS requires at least one public IP.
network.failed: Unable to read or save network configuration.
network.portsHelp: A host and port form a service endpoint. Reservations prevent another service claiming the same port/protocol. They do not open firewalls or forward router ports. TCP and UDP are separate.
network.minecraftPortHelp: Choose a free TCP port in an enabled pool. Without pools manual allocation remains available. Minecraft Java defaults to 25565. A TCP reservation for this service is promoted to its primary allocation when saving.
network.poolHelp: Up to 1000 ports between 1024 and 65535. Pools of the same protocol cannot overlap. Existing allocations are preserved. Disabling a pool prevents new reservations without stopping services.
network.label: Description (optional)
network.chooseService: Choose a service on this node
network.noPools: No pools configured. Add a range to control new allocations.
network.reservationHelp: Additional TCP/UDP reservations are not yet published by the agent. The current installer maps the primary Minecraft TCP port. A reservation does not imply an active listener.
network.existingHelp: Previous allocations were preserved. Add a pool covering these ports if needed; do not reserve them again.
network.noHost: The administrator has not set a node connection address. This does not block service startup.
network.noPorts: No inbound ports allocated. Outbound-only bots do not need inbound ports.

scope.LOCAL: Local address — access only from the computer running the service.
scope.LAN: LAN address — access requires this network and suitable firewall rules.
scope.PUBLIC: Public / DNS address — access depends on DNS, firewall and port forwarding.

errors.NETWORK_INVALID_HOST: Enter a valid host without a protocol, path or port.
errors.NETWORK_INVALID_PORT: Ports must be integers between 1024 and 65535.
errors.NETWORK_INVALID_RANGE: Enter a valid range containing up to 1000 ports.
errors.NETWORK_INVALID_LABEL: Descriptions can contain up to 80 characters.
errors.NETWORK_POOL_OVERLAP: The range overlaps an existing pool of this protocol.
errors.NETWORK_POOL_LIMIT: The node pool limit has been reached.
errors.NETWORK_POOL_IN_USE: This pool has allocations. Disable it to preserve them.
errors.NETWORK_PORT_OUTSIDE_POOL: The port is outside enabled pools for this protocol.
errors.NETWORK_PORT_IN_USE: This port and protocol are already allocated.
errors.NETWORK_SERVICE_NODE_MISMATCH: The service must belong to this node.
errors.NETWORK_RESERVATION_LIMIT: The service reservation limit has been reached.
errors.NETWORK_SERVICE_NOT_FOUND: Service not found or access denied.
errors.NETWORK_MANAGED_PORT: This port belongs to a Valheim installation allocation and cannot be released separately.
